CreatureTypeImages.Title: Creature Type Images
CreatureTypeImages.MenuHint: Override the image used for any creature type in the percentage-blend UI.

ClassBackgrounds.Title: Class Backgrounds
ClassBackgrounds.MenuHint: Assign a header banner and body texture per class - a character's sheet blends these once every class they have is fully configured.

CardColors.Title: Damage Type Card Colors
CardColors.MenuHint: Choose the icon color for each damage type shown on attack/damage chat cards. The damage type name itself is shown as a hover tooltip instead of permanent text.

HideDamageOnMiss.Name: Hide Damage on a Miss
HideDamageOnMiss.Hint: dnd5e/midi-qol pre-roll damage even when an attack misses. Choose whether that damage is hidden on the card when the attack didn't land.
HideDamageOnMiss.Players: Hide from players (GM still sees it)

RollBreakdown.ModeHint: Controls the per-roll modifier breakdown on attack/damage chat cards (e.g. why an attack is +3, or what made up a damage total). "Player Choice" lets each player decide via their own Show Roll Breakdown setting below.
RollBreakdown.ClientHint: Show the modifier breakdown on attack/damage chat cards, when the world's Roll Breakdown Display setting is set to Player Choice.

CreatureBlendGrant.Title: Creature Blend Grant
CreatureBlendGrant.Hint: Automatically grants item(s) once a creature type reaches a percentage threshold in the actor's Creature Type Blend.
CreatureBlendGrant.DropHint: Drag items here to grant them once the threshold is reached.

threshold.label: Threshold
threshold.hint: Percentage of the blend this type must reach for the items below to be granted.
